correctness.rationale: Complete finite-group Fourier diagonalization including quotient factor 1/2; exact central-coefficient evaluation for even and odd n; factorial sign, log-convex ratios and endpoint comparisons prove all weights and sharp QEC. Exact independent Krawtchouk and direct graph Walsh checks through n=70 and 10, respectively.

value.rationale: The graph-distance QEC is a natural analytic invariant, governing conditional negative type and small-time Gaussian kernel positivity. Exact four-periodic extremizing harmonic switch plus full signed spectrum and inertia across an unbounded canonical family is structural and substantially more informative than routine finite evaluation.
